messages.subject: Maple Court Care Home - draft inspection report for factual accuracy
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Pryce,

Please find issued to your provider portal the draft inspection report for Maple Court Care Home following our inspection of 11-12 February 2025. You have 10 working days from today to submit factual accuracy comments (by 27 March 2025).

Regards,
Jane Hartley
Inspection Manager, Adult Social Care
Care Quality Commission

messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Hartley,

Thank you. Our legal advisers are assisting with the factual accuracy comments. Given the volume of supporting records, would the Commission agree a short extension to 3 April 2025? We want to provide properly evidenced comments.

Kind regards,
Daniel Pryce
